title.zh-CN: Can’t Stop：同一把骰子，为什么越走越难停？
title.en: Can’t Stop: Why Does the Same Handful of Dice Become Harder to Put Down?

summary.en: Use two worked situations to compare dice pairing, three temporary runners, banking, and the choices removed when a column is won.
